task: Explore: STL decomposition (Cleveland et al. 1990) as the seventh research-algorithms-as-tools venture

errors.what: First reference comparison: robust-mode weights differed (up to 0.077) because the engine recomputed weights after the final pass; statsmodels returns those used in it.
errors.fix: Dropped the extra recompute; all 9 cases now agree to 2.6e-11.

errors.what: CLI defaulted to the last numeric column (NOAA's deseasonalized column) instead of the first.
errors.fix: Default is now the first numeric non-date column; caught by running the CLI on the example.

doc_friction.issue: Recent explore records were the fastest way to avoid repeating ideas, but there is no command for 'list recent explore ideas'; I grepped prompts/runs/*.json by hand.

Registering a new venture touches launched.json, build.mjs RESEARCH_ALGORITHM_SLUGS and the SWITCHES_IN_THE_CATALOGUE count in optout-persistence.test.mjs; only the test failure told me about the last one.

deviations.why: An initial inputmode sweep idea was dropped after finding wall-framing inputs intentionally accept feet-inches text (a false-positive-prone heuristic).
deviations.did: Picked the STL research-tool candidate instead.

notes: Explore idea: STL decomposition (portfolio/research-tools candidate) as venture stl-decomposition. Engine from the paper; 9 statsmodels 0.15.0 cases agree on trend/seasonal/resid/weights to 2.6e-11. Finding: Mauna Loa CO2 seasonal swing 6.33 -> 6.66 ppm (1975-84 vs 2016-25), ~0.09 ppm/decade, stable across 4 smoothing settings; STL adjusted within 0.075 ppm mean of NOAA's deseasonalized column. No separate agent doc: the venture README and research-tools README carry what the next run needs (MSTL next).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: engine from paper + statsmodels differential test, CLI, page, tests, README, post: about two working days for a statistician-developer

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id

certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
